finding: The geometry-supported conflict recovery (--geometry-guided-conflict-recovery, recover_conflict_tracks_geometry) improves the connected-run mapper over the union-find default when the candidate/matching stages are held fixed: it registers more images at 1k/5k/10k, roughly neutral at 2.5k, and consistently lowers mean reprojection and raises track count. The 10k registration rises 199 -> 213, but the scale collapse (1.2k plateau) is not resolved by this change alone.

change.detail: Expose --geometric-confidence-tracks, --cycle-supported-tracks and --geometry-guided-conflict-recovery and pass them into build_mapper_command. Previously only --confidence-ordered-tracks was reachable from the runner; the example already implemented the other track strategies.

method: Mapping-only A/B on the frozen M5 verified-pair snapshots (candidate generation and matching held fixed), so the comparison isolates the mapper/track-builder. Each tier uses the frozen per-tier periodic-BA threshold (images + 1: 1001/2501/5001/10001), which disables the periodic BA schedule. The treatment arm appends --geometry-guided-conflict-recovery.

results.note: The baseline exactly reproduces the frozen M5 tier-5000 model stats (1212 / 3318 / 1.072 px), confirming the flag value is correct.
Only 199 images register, below every candidate periodic-BA threshold, so the earlier 1001 value happened to be equivalent here.

correction: An earlier version of this evidence used --periodic-ba-min-registered-images 1001 for every tier. That is the tier-1000 value; the frozen per-tier value is images+1. The mistake made the 5k mapper run a global BA every five registrations after 1001 (about 40 s each), which was misread as a ~10x mapper regression. With the correct 5001 value the current code reproduces the frozen tier-5000 model exactly (1212 / 3318 / 1.072 px), so there is no mapper regression.
decision: Adopt --geometry-guided-conflict-recovery for the connected-run mapper: it is neutral-to-positive on registration and consistently improves reprojection/track support. The 10k registration remains far below the 1.2k plateau, so the scale problem persists and is not solved by this switch alone.
